purpose: Applicability/routing of the original 250 user topics; not official institutional coverage or 250 confirmed vulnerabilities.

categories.core: Routinely consider the relevant web trust boundary; not an automatic finding.
categories.conditional: Assess when the component/feature/processing exists or an evidenced risk makes it relevant.
categories.supporting: Testing, assurance, operations or governance practice; not an independent exploit.
categories.context: Architecture/conceptual tool; inspect actual assumptions without prescribing new infrastructure.
